name: My Big Bad Wolf
source:
On the way to visit her grandma, Ruby Ryder has a choice encounter with the big bad wolf herself. Despite their rocky start, the two form an unlikely friendship. As the lines between romance and platonic affection are blurred, Ruby is forced to make a choice. The expectations of those around her, or her own happiness.

[From [url=https://scrappydoodles.itch.io/my-big-bad-wolf]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在去看望奶奶的路上，鲁比·莱德遭遇了大灰狼本人。尽管起步不顺利，两人却建立了一种不太可能的友谊。随着浪漫和柏拉图式爱情之间的界限变得模糊，鲁比被迫做出选择。是周围人的期望，还是她自己的幸福。

[来自[url=https://scrappydoodles.itch.io/my-big-bad-wolf]Itch.io[/url]]
